title: [review] project-LICHEN-worker10: NotAdmitted variants are dead code — never constructed
description:
## Summary

Commit 1ad4adcc added `NotAdmitted` variants to three locations:
1. `DaoProcessError::NotAdmitted` in `rust/lichen-rpl/src/routing.rs:822`
2. `DaoHandlingOutcome::NotAdmitted` in `rust/lichen-node/src/node.rs:86`
3. Match arm in `handle_dao()` at `rust/lichen-node/src/node.rs:378`

## Finding

`DaoProcessError::NotAdmitted` is **never constructed** anywhere — zero instances across all 22 `DaoProcessError::\*` construction sites in `lichen-rpl`. The match arm at `node.rs:378` is unreachable at runtime. The admission check is already performed correctly at a higher layer via `RplReceiveOutcome::DaoOriginNotAdmitted` in `rpl_stack.rs:1333`, which gates before `handle_dao()` is called.

## Impact

- `DaoHandlingOutcome::NotAdmitted` is a **public API variant** that will never be returned — misleading to callers who might match on it
- The `DaoProcessError::NotAdmitted` variant suggests admission checking happens inside the DAO processing path, but it does not
- Dead code increases maintenance burden and confuses future readers

## Recommended Fix

Either:
- **A.** Remove `NotAdmitted` from all three locations (since admission is handled at a higher layer via `RplReceiveOutcome::DaoOriginNotAdmitted`), or
- **B.** Wire the admission check into `process_signature_verified_inner` in `lichen-rpl/src/routing.rs` so the variant can actually be produced, and remove the higher-level admission gate in `rpl_stack.rs` to avoid duplicate checks
